closed_findings.title: Preparation transaction gate
closed_findings.evidence: Incomplete marker rejects; complete marker binds deployment ID, epoch and manifest; freeze publishes complete last. Interrupted and missing-complete negative cases pass.
closed_findings.limit: The reviewer did not execute freeze or create a new candidate.

closed_findings.title: Preparation file identity and same-byte verification
closed_findings.evidence: PublicFiles pins directories root-first with access 0x81/share 1, opens leaves without following reparse points, snapshots all validated input bytes, loads the same verifier PE byte array by reflection, exclusively creates and holds output files, verifies output set/length/hash and publishes the ID/epoch/manifest complete marker. Fourteen preparation tests and all 475 prepared files/474 checksum entries read back; current verifier independently inspects the 194-file unsigned fixture and rejects signed verification.
closed_findings.limit: Public-data simulation and bounded file-system checks; no real user certificate, CNG operation, installation or production qualification.

closed_findings.title: Public preview rejects PFX before construction
closed_findings.evidence: Shared PublicCertificate checks content type Cert before constructing X509Certificate2, then requires exact RawData and no private key. Preview, verifier and preparation reuse it. Exact DER and keyless PKCS12 tests pass; current verifier independently rejects the existing keyless public PKCS12 with PUBLIC_DER_ONLY_NO_PFX.
closed_findings.limit: No private-key-bearing PFX was read, imported or created by this reviewer.

certificate_and_cms_policy.trust_anchor: Independently checked exact public certificate DER SHA256; Subject alone is not trust.
certificate_and_cms_policy.identity_binding: Exact Subject checked; Issuer and serial are exposed as metadata and are also fixed by the complete DER pin.
certificate_and_cms_policy.binding: machine ID, operator/service SID, host, epoch, times, deployment ID, full payload manifest/config/policy/changes, installer/verifier/signer hashes, count/bytes; approval also binds raw plan and CMS.
certificate_and_cms_policy.production: Local EKU rejected even for legacy configs; codeSigning leaf EKU, codeSigning ApplicationPolicy and Windows chain with Offline revocation/NoFlag required.
certificate_and_cms_policy.public_certificate_gate: Before X509Certificate2 construction: require Cert content type and bounded size; after construction require exact RawData and no private-key association.

cng_assessment.public_load: Read-only My-store selection, certificate metadata and provider association; no GetRSAPrivateKey in this phase.
cng_assessment.attribute_access: Separate explicit consent before CngKey.Open; Silent does not make the returned handle metadata-only.
cng_assessment.final_signing: Separate final Yes precedes GetRSAPrivateKey; current policy and public modulus/exponent checked, then certificate-associated Framework CMS is verified against exact DER pin.
cng_assessment.isolation_requirement: Independent signing device/security principal inaccessible to the agent; another desktop/session of the same SID is insufficient.
cng_assessment.creator_script: Statically reviewed only. Creation plus subsequent private-key-associated metadata access requires explicit consent; no key export/trust import/automatic cleanup or retry. Public executable bootstrap hashes and Assembly.Load use the same byte array. Method selection now uses the same case-insensitive behavior as ValidateSet; both requested provider choices retain their meaning.

build_evidence.verification: Recorded compiler log hashes and all six current PE hashes independently read back; no rebuild by this reviewer.

simulated_signing_evidence.verification: All 107 recorded cases and their 321 input/stdout/stderr originals/delivered copies checked. No signing fixture generator or full test suite rerun by this reviewer.
simulated_signing_evidence.oid_test_interpretation: cms-signature-oid-pss and unknown assert parser output UNSUPPORTED. Their ACCEPTED harness status means the expected-value assertion succeeded, not that those CMS algorithms are permitted.

regression_evidence.verification: Final original/delivered logs and TAP counts checked; regression not rerun by this reviewer.
